Booster Boss

Lieutenant · Gang leader

Chrome, a mohawk, wolvers. Rules the block by fear and collects “taxes.”

Tactics: Leads 4–6 boosters. Jumps into melee himself and goes berserk when wounded.

HP 40 · Seriously Wounded 20 · Death Save 7

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
